scope: Retry-safe edit, delete and report behavior for CHAT-MESSAGE-ACTIONS, recomposed over current main with byte-equivalent product blobs and a committed selective production database release.

validation.affectedPlatformBaseline: 84 Web/Wasm tests, Android debug compilation and nine iOS x64 tests passed on the exact affected runtime blobs preserved at the recomposed head
validation.selectiveReleaseExecutor: read-only dry-run, authorization gate, atomic rollback and exact apply fixture passed

cleanup.mode: failed release attempts rolled back atomically; predeploy and postdeploy fixtures rolled back; disposable restore target removed

preservedFailures: The first persistent release attempt failed closed because its catalog postcondition named the edit text argument incorrectly; commitStatus was rolled_back and a fresh predeploy probe proved the target objects and fixture remained absent.

The second persistent release attempt failed closed because its definition assertion did not match the exact versioned error phrase; commitStatus was rolled_back and a fresh predeploy probe again proved zero persistent target objects and fixture residue.

The first broad historical iOS run passed all 52 ChatViewModel tests while one unrelated inbox pagination repository test exhausted its virtual timeout; all nine changed mutation methods passed in the accepted focal run.

A general restore of a Supabase logical dump into vanilla PostgreSQL is not claimed because the target lacks managed Supabase roles and extensions; the fresh encrypted dump passed both hashes and the selective restore drill.
limits: No platform matrix was repeated solely for the recomposed SHA: all affected runtime and migration blobs are byte-equivalent to the reviewed product baseline, while the changed release tooling, contracts, database path and exact production state were renewed.
This focal unit completes CHAT-MESSAGE-ACTIONS recovery and its production database boundary; it does not declare global SCR-CHAT acceptance or acceptance of actions owned by other subflows.
